title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: When kids are hard on themselves
hook: A player is more upset about a mistake than anyone else.
intro: They are still talking about it at the end of practice.
statement: Some kids need help letting go more than they need a correction.
q1: Do you talk with them about mistakes being normal —
q2: or keep things light and move on quickly?
q3: Where might that pressure come from?
t1: Every kid is different. But kids relax
t2: when they know mistakes are part of learning.
cta: Coaches — how do you help them?
ctaLines: A private talk. A laugh. Share your own mistakes.
Talk it through or move on?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player is more upset about a mistake than anyone else.
No one else noticed it. They are still talking about it at the end of practice.
Some kids need help letting go more than they need a correction.
Talk it through or move on quickly. Both can work.
How do you help them? Share your habit in the comments.
